goal: Retrieve the S.S. Ticket from Bill

subgoals.goal_text: Heal the party at the Cerulean City Pokemon Center to ensure they are healthy for the trip south.
Travel south from Cerulean City through Route 5 and Route 6 to reach Vermilion City.
Enter the S.S. Anne from the Vermilion City docks.
Move from the main deck into the interior rooms of the S.S. Anne.
Go up to the second floor of the S.S. Anne.
Enter the rooms on the second floor of the S.S. Anne.
Locate and speak with Bill in his room on the S.S. Anne to receive the S.S. Ticket.
